remarks: Gorgeous new construction by renowned builder and architect team Sterling Associates and Katherine Eberly. Incredibly functional flow, light and airy, gracious back yard, in the Hindley School district. 46 hillside boasts 9 foot ceiling throughout. This NEW New England colonial has every room one could need- formal living room, formal dining room, and formal powder room for easy entertaining at the front of the house, and a large, open concept kitchen and family room overlooking a private, expansive yard in the back of the house. The back of house is mostly glass, letting in an incredible amount of natural light, and nature. The family room has a gas fireplace, wet bar, and cozy window seat. Off the kitchen, you will find a walk in pantry. Beyond the pantry, you will find a second, informal powder room, a massive mudroom, and an oversized 2 car garage. The second floor has 5 bedrooms total. The master has two large walk-in closets (his and hers), his and hers vanities, a stunning soaking tub, large shower, and separate WC. All of the non-primary bedrooms are spacious; two have en suite baths, and the other two share a grand Jack-and-Jill bathroom. The lower level is nearly 1000 sf of bonus, customizable space. There is an egress window for a 6th bed option, or create your dream gym or rec room. Importantly, don;t miss the gorgeous blue-stone patio and outdoor kithcen! Construction will be completed by end of July 2024.
